title: Protocol and Static
author: Paloma Vasquez
blurb: Bram Lockridge, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
